a.text: Honest concern: there is an 80% storm chance after every round, so round 1 will very likely be the last. If we both operate, we both almost certainly end with 0 and fail. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one of us. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break our deal silently. Options are a coin-flip style split (for example, whoever's message leads), or sticking with the plan if you prefer. What do you want to do? I'll tell you my real action before I act.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. You didn't agree to renegotiate, so I'm sticking with our original deal: I operated this round and will keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take 4. No taking early from me.
Operating again. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take 4.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
